question: Should this protected, multi-surface Control UI refactor be accepted after a refreshed whole-surface review and representative runtime proof?
rationale: The repository policy keeps `maintainer`-labeled items open for explicit maintainer handling, and shared lifecycle ownership affects several independent UI paths.

options.title: Review and land the consolidation
options.body: Confirm each migrated UI surface preserves its existing cleanup, request-generation, focus, and resource-release behavior, then merge after current-head proof.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Separate the shared controllers into smaller independently reviewable PRs if the combined lifecycle surface is too broad to validate confidently.
